Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage, and consider Thornmail between core items because her attacks rely on basic attacks. Armor can’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your maximum health, so armor or health alone can’t block all her damage.
Camille.combo: Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to send the blade through Camille, then taunt her with Shen E Shadow Dash and land three empowered attacks. While Camille Q Precision Protocol’s empowered attack is coming back up, check the blade’s position and block it with Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
Camille.escape: Camille E Hookshot being down gives you a chance to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash, but account for Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum if it’s still available, since she has another escape option. Shen E Shadow Dash is your only mobility spell, so use it first only when you’re sure you can win. If the angle looks unreliable, save it to answer her next engage.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield. After the shield has been stripped away, take a short fight from an angle where Shen Q Twilight Assault’s blade passes through Camille.
Camille.laning: Stay away from walls and among minions to avoid being cornered near a wall by Camille E Hookshot. Manage the wave and your health safely instead of forcing trades, and contest Camille’s farming when you safely can before she completes her first core item. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United on another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Camille.phase: Shen is weak early, but Camille is also weak before her first core item and clears waves slowly, so contest her farming from a safe position. From mid game onward, Camille can take turrets quickly when left in a side lane, so don’t leave a side lane unattended.
Camille.teamfight: If Camille engages on an allied carry with Camille E Hookshot, taunt her with Shen E Shadow Dash to peel her off, and manage the blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers the carry’s position. Use Shen R Stand United after an ally starts taking damage, when you judge they can survive until the channel completes.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot’s wall-based engage and stun are dangerous, so stay away from walls and watch for Camille W Tactical Sweep overlapping during movement. Don’t waste Shen E Shadow Dash at the moment Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages; endure the area while it lasts, then counterattack.

Aurora.teamfight: If Aurora engages on an allied carry, taunt her with Shen E Shadow Dash to peel her off, and manage the blade so it stays near your carry. Shen W Spirit's Refuge blocks only basic attacks, so don’t use it to block Aurora’s magic abilities. If Aurora dives in and gets no takedown, you have a chance to catch her. If an ally is killed, Aurora W Across the Veil may become available again, so don’t leave a low-health ally behind.
Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance before armor. Make your third item something that adds magic resistance, such as Bandlepipes, to buy time in fights. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Aurora.combo: Use Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash taunt → three empowered attacks. Aim Shen Q Twilight Assault so the blade passes through Aurora to increase your empowered attack damage and attack speed. If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, wait until she reappears or identify where she’ll arrive before using Shen E Shadow Dash.
Aurora.escape: Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding both being down gives you an opening to close in with Shen E Shadow Dash. If Aurora R Between Worlds is also still on cooldown, she has fewer ways to escape. If only one mobility spell is down, she can still get away with the other, so don’t rush your engage.
Aurora.fight: If you stay too long after Aurora’s poke has lowered your health, the return damage from Aurora Q Twofold Hex becomes dangerous, so take short trades. Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to send the blade through Aurora, land empowered attacks, then back off. If you use Shen E Shadow Dash first, you have no way out, so be careful while Aurora still has mobility available.
Aurora.laning: Make Shen Q Twilight Assault graze Aurora to shorten the time until Shen P Ki Barrier comes back, and repeat short trades. If you see a chance to join another lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Aurora.phase: In the mid to late game, look for opportunities to join fights in time with Shen R Stand United’s cooldown.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when the curse is pulled back, and that damage increases the lower your health is. If you’re cursed, leave the line between Aurora and you, and retreat before the curse returns if your health is in a dangerous range. Aurora R Between Worlds slows you when you leave its area, so decide whether to escape before the zone appears.

Aatrox.combo: Set up an angle for the blade to pass through Aatrox, then use Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash taunt → three empowered attacks. Cast Shen Q Twilight Assault first so you can land empowered attacks during the taunt, while Shen P Ki Barrier helps reduce health lost. Don’t force this combo while the outer edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is still a threat.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, avoid giving up a kill, farm safely, and aim to keep the lane even. If Shen Q Twilight Assault’s blade passes through Aatrox, Shen P Ki Barrier comes back sooner, giving you an opening for a short trade. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United on another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Aatrox.build: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains deal most of their damage as physical damage, so build armor first. If Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance, Aatrox E Umbral Dash, and Aatrox R World Ender’s healing become a problem in extended fights, get resistances first, then add Grievous Wounds.
Aatrox.escape: Aatrox E Umbral Dash creates an opening to close the distance right after he uses it. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains is also down and you’ve avoided the outer edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, you can engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, use Shen E Shadow Dash to escape its area.
Aatrox.fight: Avoid the outer edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, then take a short trade. A good opening is right after he uses the empowered attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. When you need to absorb a basic attack, block it with Shen W Spirit's Refuge. Save Shen E Shadow Dash to avoid a counterattack, and use it to engage only when you’re sure you can win.
Aatrox.teamfight: Stay near your allied carries to stop enemy engages with Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt, and manage the blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers your carry’s position. Shen W Spirit's Refuge blocks only basic attacks, so dodge Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade by moving. Use Shen R Stand United after an ally starts taking damage, when you judge they can survive until the channel completes.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals dangerous damage and knocks you up, so watch its cast animation and move outside the blade’s outer edge or close in toward its center. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave the area immediately and use your held Shen E Shadow Dash if needed. Aatrox R World Ender increases his healing, so create distance and wait for its duration to expire.

Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and lowers armor and magic resistance, so avoid taking a direct hit. When your health is low, watch out for Kayle E Starfire Spellblade, which deals damage based on missing health, and time Shen W Spirit's Refuge to block her empowered basic attacks. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t pour in damage; use the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash to run out the invulnerability.
Kayle.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Kayle’s main damage. Choose a magic resistance item such as Bandlepipes as your third item to give yourself more time to withstand her. Kayle Q Radiant Blast lowers resistances, so avoid a direct hit even after you’ve built items.
Kayle.combo: Position so your spirit blade can pass through Kayle, then use Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash → three empowered basic attacks.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no movement ability to create distance on her own, so look to approach after Kayle Q Radiant Blast misses or she uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Taunt first with Shen E Shadow Dash to limit her chance to use the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, you have no movement ability left to escape, so check your engage angle first.
Kayle.laning: Look for chances to deny Kayle CS and experience early, while managing the wave safely without spending too much of Shen’s health. Make short trades by positioning Shen Q Twilight Assault’s blade to graze Kayle, reducing the time until Shen P Ki Barrier comes back. If a fight is expected where you’ll leave lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward Kayle’s turret first.
Kayle.teamfight: As a rule, manage your blade position beside your allied damage dealers and use Shen E Shadow Dash to peel enemies off them. Place Shen W Spirit's Refuge where your damage dealer is to block Kayle’s basic attacks. If you have a chance to reach Kayle directly, coordinate with your team’s crowd control and engage from the side or outside vision, then focus damage after the invulnerability from Kayle R Divine Judgment ends.

Renekton.escape: Your window to engage is after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage and Renekton W Ruthless Predator is down. If he also has no Fury and you can win, engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. Otherwise, save Shen E Shadow Dash to stop his next engage.
Renekton.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. If you also need to withstand frequent basic attacks, fit Thornmail between your core items. Account for the magic damage from Renekton R Dominus and the armor reduction from empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice when positioning.
Renekton.combo: Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to make the Spirit Blade pass through Renekton, then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash. If you use only Shen Q Twilight Assault and back off, you waste the empowered basic attack damage.
Renekton.fight: Trade briefly when Renekton has no Fury. After he uses Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice, retaliate while blocking his remaining basic attacks with Shen W Spirit's Refuge. Angle Shen Q Twilight Assault so the Spirit Blade passes through Renekton, then land empowered attacks.
Renekton.laning: Early on, manage your health and the wave safely instead of forcing trades. Watch for Renekton to step forward to build Fury, but be wary of an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator when his Fury is close to half. If you see a chance to join another lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Renekton.phase: Renekton's value falls off from the mid game onward, so avoid giving him kills, keep farming, and make the most of opportunities to use Shen R Stand United.
Renekton.teamfight: Taunt Renekton with Shen E Shadow Dash to peel him off an allied damage dealer. Keep the Spirit Blade near your damage dealer and use Shen W Spirit's Refuge to block basic attacks coming into that area. Use Shen R Stand United after your ally actually takes damage, when they can survive until the channel completes.
Renekton.watch: Avoid trading into Renekton W Ruthless Predator when his Fury is above or just below half. Empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator breaks shields first, so don't rely on Shen P Ki Barrier to absorb it. Renekton E Slice and Dice can use minions to enable a second dash, so don't stand among or behind a group of minions.

Chogath.phase: Cho'Gath gets stronger as he stacks, making him harder to face over time, so pressure him early from a safe range. In the mid to late game, help other lanes in time with Shen R Stand United’s cooldown, and don’t give Cho'Gath champion kills that let him stack more.
Chogath.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Shen W Spirit's Refuge can’t block this main damage, so make your third item something that adds magic resistance, such as Bandlepipes. Resistances don’t work against Cho'Gath R Feast’s true damage, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about building health alone.
Chogath.combo: Check the Spirit Blade’s position and cast Shen Q Twilight Assault from an angle that sends it through Cho'Gath. Then taunt with Shen E Shadow Dash and land three empowered attacks. If you use only Shen Q Twilight Assault and back off, you won’t make use of the empowered attack damage.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility spell, so right after he uses Cho'Gath Q Rupture on the wave is an opportunity to engage. Avoid the frontal silence area of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then close in with Shen E Shadow Dash. If the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture appears beneath you or the engage isn’t certain, save Shen E Shadow Dash as your way out.
Chogath.fight: Dodge the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture to the side, then take a short trade while avoiding the frontal area of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream. Use Shen Q Twilight Assault so the Spirit Blade passes through Cho'Gath, taking advantage of the empowered attacks’ maximum-health damage and attack speed. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, Cho'Gath can counterattack and you have no way out, so use it to engage only when you’re sure you can win.
Chogath.laning: Step out of the line so Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes can’t hit both you and the minions, and use short trades to drain Cho'Gath’s resources. Take chances to pressure him and limit the time he has to stack, but push the wave toward the enemy turret before leaving with Shen R Stand United.
Chogath.teamfight: Use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt and peel off anyone engaging on an allied carry. Manage the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers your carry’s position, but don’t try to use the zone to block Cho'Gath’s ability damage. Use Shen R Stand United after an ally takes damage and when they can survive until the channel completes.
Chogath.watch: When the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture appears beneath you, immediately walk to the side to dodge it. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, you can’t escape with Shen E Shadow Dash, so don’t start a direct trade. Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes passes through minions, so step out of the line when Cho'Gath attacks. If your health is at or below half, keep your distance to avoid Cho'Gath R Feast’s true damage.

Trundle.watch: Trundle’s attacks and healing are stronger on Trundle W Frozen Domain, so move outside it and fight once the effect ends. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape route and slows you, so avoid narrow paths and move sideways as soon as the pillar appears. During Trundle R Subjugate, your defensive stats are reduced and Trundle becomes tougher, so create distance.
Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Since basic attacks are his main damage source, also consider an effect that reduces attack speed. Trundle R Subjugate deals percent maximum-health damage and steals resistances, so do not try to survive by stacking only health or resistances.
Trundle.combo: Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to call the Spirit Blade toward Trundle and make it pass through him, then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash. Follow with three empowered attacks, and if Trundle fights back with basic attacks, use Shen W Spirit's Refuge where the blade is. If you only use Shen Q Twilight Assault and back off, you cannot deal empowered attack damage.
Trundle.escape: The opportunity to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash comes after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and the effect of Trundle W Frozen Domain has ended. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, but Shen E Shadow Dash is also your only mobility ability, so use it first only in a fight you can win. If Trundle R Subjugate is active, delay your engage and create distance.
Trundle.fight: Trade briefly outside Trundle W Frozen Domain, then back off. Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to make the Spirit Blade pass through Trundle, then land empowered attacks to benefit from percent maximum-health damage and increased attack speed. When Trundle’s basic attacks keep coming, check the blade’s position and use Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
Trundle.laning: Early on, avoid extended fights with Trundle and manage the wave safely. Trundle P King's Tribute heals him when nearby units die, so do not stay in a long standoff in front of a large wave after only chipping away at his health with poke. If you see an opportunity to join another lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward the enemy turret beforehand.
Trundle.phase: In the mid and late game, opportunities to use Shen R Stand United increase, so make team fights with your allies instead of taking side lane duels alone.
Trundle.teamfight: Instead of staying in front and fighting Trundle for a long time, Shen should taunt enemies who get onto allied damage dealers with Shen E Shadow Dash and peel them off. Manage the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers allied damage dealers and blocks basic attacks. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, create distance or attack another target instead of continuing to hit Trundle.

Nasus.fight: Position so your sword passes through Nasus, then follow up with empowered attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault. Block Nasus’s basic attacks empowered by Nasus Q Siphoning Strike with Shen W Spirit's Refuge placed at your sword’s location. Don’t force a fight while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active or you’re affected by Nasus W Wither.
Nasus.build: Nasus’s main damage is Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, so build armor first. If you can reduce his attack speed, that helps reduce his basic attack damage. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor while you stand in it, so move out of the area. Keep Nasus R Fury of the Sands in mind and be wary of building a large amount of health alone.
Nasus.combo: When your spirit blade can pass through Nasus, fight with Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash → three empowered basic attacks. If Nasus tries to trade back with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, place Shen W Spirit's Refuge where the blade is to block the basic attack.
Nasus.escape: A good window to engage is after Nasus W Wither is down and Nasus R Fury of the Sands has ended. Nasus has no ability to create distance on his own, so use Shen E Shadow Dash to catch him if you have an angle to win. Shen E Shadow Dash is Shen’s only movement ability, so save it as an escape when you can’t handle the counterattack.
Nasus.laning: Don’t keep pushing the lane so Nasus can easily stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike under his turret. Let the wave come toward you, pressure Nasus’s last-hits, and look for a jungle gank. If you see a chance to go to another lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave first to reduce the cost of leaving.
Nasus.phase: In the mid to late game, help your allies with Shen R Stand United and avoid dueling Nasus head-on.
Nasus.teamfight: Don’t stay in front of Nasus for long while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance. If Nasus gets onto an allied damage dealer, use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt him away and manage your blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge appears beside your damage dealer. Use Shen R Stand United after an ally has actually taken damage, when they can survive until the channel ends.
Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike becomes more threatening as it stacks, so don’t let him last-hit freely. Nasus W Wither makes both movement and empowered basic attacks difficult, so don’t venture deep alone. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, create distance and wait it out unless you have an advantage in both numbers and damage.

Akali.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Akali’s main damage. Choose a third item that adds magic resistance, such as Bandlepipes, and build health so you don’t easily fall into Akali R Perfect Execution’s execute range.
Akali.combo: Set up an angle for the Spirit Blade to pass through Akali, then use Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash → three empowered attacks. Look for an opening after dodging Akali E Shuriken Flip or when Akali comes out of her shroud.
Akali.escape: You have an opening to engage when Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip are down and Akali R Perfect Execution is still on cooldown. If only one mobility option is down, she can escape with the other, so don’t rush Shen E Shadow Dash.
Akali.fight: Dodge the first hit of Akali E Shuriken Flip, then take a short trade when Akali comes out of her shroud to engage. If you use Shen E Shadow Dash to engage first, you have no way out, so save it to counter her engage. Don’t chase just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down; check whether she still has another way to move.
Akali.laning: When Akali’s ultimate is unavailable, look for a short trade when she comes out of her shroud to engage. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United on another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Akali.phase: In the mid to late game, play around the cycle of Shen’s ultimate coming off cooldown, and don’t make a definite judgment about which champion has the advantage in a late-game one-on-one.
Akali.teamfight: If Akali engages on an allied carry, taunt her with Shen E Shadow Dash to peel her off. Manage the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers the carry’s position, but remember the zone blocks only basic attacks, not ability damage. Use Shen R Stand United after an ally starts taking damage and when they can survive until the channel completes.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first hit of Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, her second dash follows Shen as he retreats, so when Akali engages, hold Shen E Shadow Dash and use it in response to Akali R Perfect Execution. The second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution deals more damage based on your missing health.

Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius’s main damage. If you also need to withstand basic attacks, fit Thornmail between core items and block attacks with Shen W Spirit's Refuge. Darius E Apprehend has armor penetration and armor doesn’t work against Darius R Noxian Guillotine, so consider your total health as well.
Darius.combo: The basic sequence is Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash taunt → three empowered attacks. Use it during the window when Darius E Apprehend is down, aiming to send the blade through Darius.
Darius.escape: After Darius E Apprehend misses, you have an opening to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. Right after Darius Q Decimate is used to clear minions is also a chance for a short trade. If you use Shen E Shadow Dash to engage, you have no mobility spell left to escape, so use it first only when you’re sure you can win.
Darius.fight: Take a short trade when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. Back off before Darius P Hemorrhage stacks on you, and avoid extended fights.
Darius.laning: Early on, manage the wave safely outside Darius E Apprehend’s range. Poke briefly only right after Darius Q Decimate is used to clear minions or when Darius E Apprehend is down. If a fight is expected on another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret and look for a chance to use Shen R Stand United.
Darius.phase: In the mid to late game, use the cooldown cycle of Shen R Stand United to join allied fights.
Darius.teamfight: Use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt and peel off anyone engaging on an allied carry. Manage the Spirit Blade’s position so Shen W Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks at your carry’s position. If a low-health ally has Darius P Hemorrhage stacks, Darius R Noxian Guillotine can lead to another takedown, so check whether the ally can survive until the channel completes when using Shen R Stand United’s shield.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you’re likely to take follow-up attacks, so stay out of range and move after it misses. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks on you, create distance to drop the stacks. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s edge or stay close to reduce his healing. Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage that increases with Hemorrhage stacks, so if your health is low with stacks on you, get out of range.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first against Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, his main damage source. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper deal magic damage, which armor can’t block. If the fight is likely to drag on, get resistances first, then consider Grievous Wounds.
DrMundo.combo: After confirming Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, use Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash → three empowered attacks. Aim to send the blade through Dr. Mundo to make use of Shen Q Twilight Assault’s maximum-health damage and attack speed increase. When taking the empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, activate Shen W Spirit's Refuge where the blade is.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so if Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and you have a winning angle, engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash is your only mobility spell, so save it if the engage isn’t certain.
DrMundo.fight: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, it ignores the first immobilizing effect, so don’t use Shen E Shadow Dash first. When Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma empowers his basic attack, check the blade’s position and take the hit inside Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
DrMundo.laning: Early on, manage the wave safely instead of forcing a duel, and dodge Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw from behind minions. After a short trade, step on the canister dropped by Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases to stop its healing and passive cooldown reduction. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United on another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
DrMundo.phase: While Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available, look for advantages in another lane or around objectives instead of spending time trying to kill Dr. Mundo.
DrMundo.teamfight: If Dr. Mundo engages on an allied carry, wait until Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash. Keep the Spirit Blade near your allied carry and block Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered basic attack with Shen W Spirit's Refuge. Use Shen R Stand United after an ally starts taking damage and when they can survive the channel.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target it reaches and deals damage based on current health, so be especially careful when your health is high and keep minions between you. Block the empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma with Shen W Spirit's Refuge. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, account for its healing and movement speed increase instead of fixating on getting a takedown.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Consider Thornmail between core items to help against basic attack damage as well. Armor can’t block the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge. If the fight drags on, get resistances first, then consider Grievous Wounds.
Fiora.combo: After confirming Fiora W Riposte is down, use Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash taunt → three empowered attacks. Position the Spirit Blade to pass through Fiora so you can make better use of Shen Q Twilight Assault’s damage and attack speed increase.
Fiora.escape: Right after Fiora uses her only mobility spell, Fiora Q Lunge, is a chance to close the distance. If Fiora W Riposte is down too, engage with Shen E Shadow Dash and look for a taunt. If Fiora W Riposte is available, don’t rush Shen E Shadow Dash.
Fiora.fight: Stand on the opposite side of the vital, then briefly trade back when Fiora lunges toward it. Once Fiora W Riposte is down, set up an angle for Shen Q Twilight Assault’s blade to pass through Fiora and trade with empowered attacks. Shen E Shadow Dash leaves you with no way out after engaging, so use it first only in a trade you can win.
Fiora.laning: Early on, manage the wave safely and repeat short trades instead of forcing trades. If Shen Q Twilight Assault’s blade grazes Fiora, Shen P Ki Barrier comes back sooner. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United on another lane, push the wave toward Fiora’s turret first.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora engages on an allied carry, taunt her with Shen E Shadow Dash, and manage the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers the carry’s position. Use Shen W Spirit's Refuge to block basic attacks, but don’t assume it can block ability damage too. If Fiora targets you with Fiora R Grand Challenge, stay next to a wall to block one side of the vitals.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks attacks and immobilizing effects, then strikes back; if it blocks Shen E Shadow Dash, it also stuns you. Save Shen E Shadow Dash while Fiora W Riposte is available, and move to the side when Fiora lunges toward a vital to avoid Riposte’s strike.

Gangplank.build: If Gangplank Q Parrrley keeps poking you, build armor early in lane. Gangplank P Trial by Fire and R Cannon Barrage deal true damage that resistances can't reduce, so build health as well.
Gangplank.combo: Track where the Spirit Blade is, then attack in this order: Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash → three empowered attacks. Set up an angle for Shen Q Twilight Assault's blade to pass through Gangplank, then look to taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash after Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no skill that creates distance on its own, so Shen E Shadow Dash is good for catching him just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed and when W Remove Scurvy is down. Save Shen E Shadow Dash if an aged keg is nearby or you aren't sure you can land the taunt.
Gangplank.fight: Trade briefly just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, and back off if an aged keg is nearby. Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to make the Spirit Blade pass through Gangplank, then follow up with empowered attacks to deal damage. Shen E Shadow Dash can leave you open to a counterattack if it misses, so use it only when you have a clear angle to catch him.
Gangplank.laning: Early on, manage the wave and your health safely rather than forcing fights. Withstand Gangplank Q Parrrley's poke while letting Shen Q Twilight Assault's Spirit Blade graze him so you can use Shen P Ki Barrier again. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Gangplank.phase: In the mid and late game, help your team fight in time with Shen R Stand United's cooldown.
Gangplank.teamfight: Use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt enemies who dive your allied carries, and position the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge appears where they are. Use Shen R Stand United after an ally takes damage, when they can survive until the channel finishes. Also check whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used when deciding the timing of an objective fight.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg slows when it explodes, so you can fight near a freshly placed keg, but avoid aged kegs and spots where two kegs overlap. Shen W Spirit's Refuge blocks only basic attacks, so don't use it to try to block the ability damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley or E Powder Keg.

Garen.build: Build armor first because Garen Q Decisive Strike and E Judgment deal most of their damage as physical damage. Garen E Judgment reduces armor and Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage, so build health as well instead of relying on resistances alone. If the enemy team relies heavily on basic attacks, fit Thornmail between core items.
Garen.combo: Start after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack is used and Garen W Courage's brief shield and tenacity window has passed. Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to pull the Spirit Blade through Garen, then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash and land three empowered attacks. Use Shen W Spirit's Refuge against Garen Q Decisive Strike, but it can't block Garen E Judgment's damage.
Garen.escape: The window to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash is after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack is used and Garen W Courage's tenacity window has passed. Garen has no mobility skill, so he has few ways to create distance once caught, but using Shen E Shadow Dash to engage leaves you with no mobility skill to escape. Go in only when you're sure to win.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly just after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack is used. Angle Shen Q Twilight Assault's Spirit Blade to pass through Garen and land empowered attacks, but don't stay on him for long once Garen E Judgment starts spinning. Use Shen E Shadow Dash to engage when you're sure to win; otherwise, save it to respond to Garen approaching.
Garen.laning: Look for chances to slow Garen's growth by pushing or pressuring the lane early, but don't engage while Garen Q Decisive Strike is active. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Garen.phase: In the mid and late game, use Shen R Stand United’s cooldown cycle to help your team, and avoid forcing duels given Garen W Courage’s permanent growth stacks.
Garen.teamfight: Use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt Garen off an allied carry, and position the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge appears where they are. Shen W Spirit's Refuge blocks Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack, but not Garen E Judgment's ability damage. When using Shen R Stand United to help an ally elsewhere, use it after they start taking damage and when they can survive until the channel finishes.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack silences, so don't engage while it's active; block it with Shen W Spirit's Refuge. Garen E Judgment can't be blocked by the zone, so quickly leave its radius. If you're below half health, keep Garen R Demacian Justice in mind and stay out of its range.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, E Hop / Crunch, and R GNAR!. If Gnar deals a lot of damage with basic attacks, consider Thornmail between core items. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so armor won't block it; be careful about building only health.
Gnar.combo: Set up an angle for the Spirit Blade to pass through Gnar, then trade in this order: Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash taunt → three empowered attacks. If you need to take a Mini Gnar basic attack, check the blade's position and block it with Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
Gnar.escape: Just after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used, Gnar has no mobility available, so look for a chance to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. Just after Mega Gnar reverts to Mini Gnar is also a good time to close in and fight, since he can’t transform again for a while. If you use Shen E Shadow Dash to engage first, you’ll have no way out, so use it only when you can win.
Gnar.fight: Trade briefly when you have a chance to engage on Mini Gnar or just after Mega Gnar reverts to Mini Gnar. If Gnar E Hop / Crunch was just used, look for a chance to close the gap with Shen E Shadow Dash. Just after Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar, avoid a head-on fight and create distance until the transformation ends.
Gnar.laning: Early on, don't force trades into Mini Gnar's range; farm safely near your turret. Watch Gnar's rage bar and look for a chance to engage while he's Mini Gnar or just after he reverts from Mega Gnar. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Gnar.phase: In the mid and late game, time your plays around Shen R Stand United's cooldown, and look for a fight just after Gnar reverts from Mega Gnar to Mini Gnar.
Gnar.teamfight: Avoid positions with your back to a wall and narrow terrain so Gnar R GNAR! can't knock you into a wall. If Gnar dives an allied carry, use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt him off, and position the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge appears where they are. If you need to join a fight elsewhere, use Shen R Stand United after an ally starts taking damage, once you've confirmed they can survive until the channel finishes.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss slows, and Mini Gnar's boomerang can hit on its return, so move out of its path. If Gnar can't catch the boomerang, there will be a longer gap before his next poke. Mega Gnar's Gnar R GNAR! stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so don't stand with your back to one.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen's main damage. Armor also helps if you're taking basic attacks, but avoid building a lot of health alone because she deals damage based on maximum health. Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s center deals true damage that resistances can't block, so dodge to the side.
Gwen.combo: Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to pull the Spirit Blade through Gwen, then taunt her with Shen E Shadow Dash and land three empowered attacks. If Gwen fights back with basic attacks, check the blade's position and take them inside Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
Gwen.escape: The window to close the gap is just after making Gwen use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s stacks are full, or you can target her from outside because of Gwen W Hallowed Mist, wait for that state to end. Before engaging with Shen E Shadow Dash, consider that a miss will leave you open to a counterattack.
Gwen.fight: Look for a short trade just after Gwen uses Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Angle Shen Q Twilight Assault's Spirit Blade to pass through Gwen and land empowered attacks, but stay out of the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If you use Shen E Shadow Dash to engage first, you'll have no way out, so do so only when you're sure to win.
Gwen.laning: Trade briefly before Gwen's stacks are full. In an area with lots of minions, Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can come back quickly, so don't force a kill there. If a fight in another lane is likely to call for Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Gwen.phase: Look only for brief trades before Gwen's stacks build up. In the mid and late game, join your team's fights as Shen R Stand United comes off cooldown.
Gwen.teamfight: Use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt Gwen off an allied carry, and position the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge activates where they are. The zone blocks Gwen's basic attacks, but not her ability damage, so watch your spacing to avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! and Gwen R Needlework. Use Shen R Stand United after an ally starts taking damage and when they can survive until the channel finishes.
Gwen.watch: Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage in the center of its cone, so move sideways when she casts it to leave the center. Gwen inside Gwen W Hallowed Mist can't be targeted from outside, so enter the mist or wait for it to end. Use Shen W Spirit's Refuge to block basic attacks after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, and dodge the damage from Gwen Q Snip Snip! and R Needlework by repositioning.

Illaoi.build: Build armor first because Illaoi's main damage is physical. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't build a lot of health alone. If you're planning a dive, get Executioner's Calling early for Grievous Wounds.
Illaoi.combo: Angle the Spirit Blade to pass through Illaoi, then use Shen Q Twilight Assault first. Follow with Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt her and land three empowered attacks. If you use only Shen Q Twilight Assault and back off, you won't get the damage from your empowered attacks.
Illaoi.escape: Look for an engage just after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit and making her use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Even then, don't go in near a wall lined with tentacles; draw her out into open ground.
Illaoi.fight: Trade briefly away from walls and tentacles. Just after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit and making her use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, you have an opportunity to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. If you use Shen E Shadow Dash first, you'll have no way out, so engage only when you're sure to win.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave away from walls, and safely last hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit's range. Shen is weak early, so prioritize keeping the lane even over forcing a fight. If a fight in another lane is likely, push the wave toward the enemy turret before using Shen R Stand United.
Illaoi.phase: In the mid and late game, help your team as your ultimate comes off cooldown, but don't fight Illaoi head-on where her tentacles are set up.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don't group up in front of Illaoi R Leap of Faith; spread out while it's active to reduce the number of targets it can hit. Use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt enemies off allied carries, and position the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge appears where they are. Shen W Spirit's Refuge blocks only basic attacks, so don't expect it to stop Illaoi's ability damage.
Illaoi.watch: Prioritize dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit. If your spirit is pulled out and you can't fight, break the tether; once you're the vessel, dodge the first tentacle. While Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, don't fight near tentacles or group up with allies.

Irelia.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and W Defiant Dance. Armor won't block the magic damage from Irelia P Ionian Fervor, E Flawless Duet, and R Vanguard's Edge. Irelia's basic attacks and attack speed are the core of her damage, so effects that reduce attack speed are also useful.
Irelia.combo: Set up an angle for the Spirit Blade to pass through Irelia, then use Shen Q Twilight Assault first. Follow with Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt her and land three empowered attacks. If Irelia fights back with basic attacks, check the blade's position and use Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
Irelia.escape: Just after making Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge is a chance to close the gap with Shen E Shadow Dash. Look for an engage if Irelia E Flawless Duet is down too. If you use Shen E Shadow Dash first, you'll have no mobility skill left to escape, so go in only when you're sure to win.
Irelia.fight: Trade briefly while watching for Irelia to chain in through low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge. When she approaches and continues attacking, block her basic attacks with Shen W Spirit's Refuge. Shen E Shadow Dash is your only mobility skill, so make sure you can win before using it to engage.
Irelia.laning: After that, manage the wave and your health safely, keeping Shen's weak early game in mind. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret in advance.
Irelia.phase: In the mid and late game, play around Shen R Stand United's cooldown and focus on helping your team fight over your own lane.
Irelia.teamfight: If Irelia dives an allied carry, use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt her off. Position the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers the carry and blocks Irelia's basic attacks. Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and E Flawless Duet can have a major impact in teamfights, so prioritize disrupting her.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain in by dashing to low-health minions, so create distance when minions are about to die. Dodge Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun, and if you're trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear. Walking through the barrier deals extra damage and applies a strong slow.

Jax.build: Jax deals physical damage with Jax Q Leap Strike and magic damage with Jax W Empower and E Counter Strike, so don't focus on just one resistance. Basic attacks and attack speed are at the core of his damage, so prioritize items that reduce attack speed. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building a lot of health alone.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike is down, use Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash taunt → three empowered attacks.
Jax.escape: Just after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike is down, there's a window to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. If Counter Strike is active, first leave its stun range; if Jax may still jump in, don't use Shen E Shadow Dash to engage.
Jax.fight: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, don't use Shen Q Twilight Assault's empowered attacks; back off. Once Counter Strike is down, use Shen Q Twilight Assault to pull the Spirit Blade through Jax and trade briefly. If Jax engages with Jax Q Leap Strike, it's safer to answer with Shen E Shadow Dash.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee trade, so don't force one. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Jax.teamfight: Don't group up with allies, since Jax E Counter Strike can stun everyone around him when he jumps in. After Counter Strike ends, use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt Jax off your allied carries, and position the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks where they are.
Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, it dodges Shen's basic attacks, and it can stun and damage you when it ends. Stop auto-attacking and back out of stun range, and save Shen E Shadow Dash in case Jax closes in with Jax Q Leap Strike.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance can't block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and because Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on your maximum health, build movement speed to escape its telegraphed area instead of stacking health alone.
Jayce.combo: Position the Spirit Blade to pass through Jayce, then use Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash → three basic attacks. Don't force this combo if Jayce still has his knockback or the angle makes Shen E Shadow Dash likely to miss.
Jayce.escape: Just after making Jayce use Jayce Q To the Skies! is a chance to close the gap with Shen E Shadow Dash. Check whether Jayce E Thundering Blow's knockback is down too before engaging to reduce the risk of being pushed away and having your trade interrupted.
Jayce.fight: Rather than taking Jayce's early strength head-on, trade briefly and make him spend resources. Fight when you can angle Shen Q Twilight Assault's Spirit Blade to pass through Jayce and follow up with empowered attacks. Using Shen E Shadow Dash to engage leaves you with no way out, so save it for a clear opportunity.
Jayce.laning: Early on, farm safely by moving sideways to dodge the line of Jayce Q Shock Blast. If health has been chipped away, don't force yourself to stay; clear the wave, then return. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret in advance to reduce your lane losses.
Jayce.phase: In the mid and late game, join your team's fights as Shen R Stand United comes off cooldown and protect the backline.
Jayce.teamfight: If Jayce jumps onto an allied carry with Jayce Q To the Skies!, use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt him off. Position the Spirit Blade near the carry and block basic attacks with Shen W Spirit's Refuge. Look for a chance to engage when Jayce's leap is down and he has no mobility available.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce is in cannon form and places Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so move sideways out of its line. When he's in hammer form, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. Jayce R Mercury Cannon reduces your resistance with his first basic attack after switching weapons, so block it with Shen W Spirit's Refuge if you're going to be hit.

Kled.build: Kled’s main damage is physical, with a high share from basic attacks, so build armor first. You can fit Thornmail between core items. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deals magic damage that armor can’t block. Kled also has damage based on maximum health, so avoid building a large amount of health alone.
Kled.combo: Set up an angle where your blade can pass through Kled, then use Shen Q Twilight Assault → taunt with Shen E Shadow Dash → three empowered basic attacks. If Kled fights back with Kled W Violent Tendencies, check your blade’s position and cast Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
Kled.escape: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, save Shen E Shadow Dash so you can create distance before it pulls you in. Look for an engage only after Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are both down, and when you’re sure you can win the fight. If only one movement ability is down, he can escape with the other, so don’t rush the chase.
Kled.fight: Take short trades and position so Shen Q Twilight Assault’s blade passes through Kled. When Kled engages, counter with Shen E Shadow Dash, and block Kled W Violent Tendencies’ basic attacks with Shen W Spirit's Refuge, which appears where the blade is. Only choose a fight where you use Shen E Shadow Dash first if you’re sure you can win.
Kled.laning: Early on, manage the wave and your health safely rather than forcing trades. If you’ve dismounted Kled, watch his Courage meter and create distance if you can’t finish him. Dismounted Kled can still build Courage by killing minions or attacking the turret, so pressure him to keep him from farming when possible.
Kled.phase: Kled weakens as the lane and mid game progress, while Shen grows more influential in the mid to late game, so playing safely through the early game is advantageous.
Kled.teamfight: Secure vision on the flanks to prepare for Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!’s long-range engage. If you can’t stop the engage, stand in front to protect your backline’s formation, then use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt Kled off an allied damage dealer. Keep your blade near your damage dealer and use Shen W Spirit's Refuge to block basic attacks.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance before it pulls you in. Kled W Violent Tendencies concentrates damage based on your maximum health into its fourth basic attack, so when Kled starts attacking, block it with Shen W Spirit's Refuge or briefly back away.

Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Consider a magic resistance item such as Bandlepipes as your third item. Block Malphite W Thunderclap’s empowered basic attacks with Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
Malphite.combo: When your spirit blade can pass through Malphite, use Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash → three empowered basic attacks.
Malphite.escape: While Malphite R Unstoppable Force is available, keep in mind that its unstoppable dash can’t be interrupted with Shen E Shadow Dash.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield before starting a trade that deals damage to his actual health. Use Shen Q Twilight Assault so your spirit blade passes through Malphite and increases the damage based on maximum health. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, you leave yourself open to a counterattack, so use it to engage only when you’re sure you can win.
Malphite.laning: Poke at short intervals to keep Malphite P Granite Shield from recharging, but don’t spend too much of Shen’s health. If a fight looks likely to break out in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret before using Shen R Stand United.
Malphite.phase: In the mid to late game, play around the timing of Shen R Stand United coming off cooldown.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid having several people knocked airborne by Malphite R Unstoppable Force, and don’t group up when you don’t know where Malphite is. Counterattack as soon as Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, and use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt enemies off your allied damage dealers. Keep your spirit blade close to your damage dealers so Shen W Spirit's Refuge can block basic attacks.
Malphite.watch: Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash, so don’t try to interrupt it with Shen E Shadow Dash. When you don’t know where Malphite is, spread out from your allies. Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, so don’t start a trade right after it hits.

Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. Olaf E Reckless Swing’s true damage can’t be reduced by resistances, so get health as well. Since he relies heavily on basic attacks, fit Thornmail between core items.
Olaf.combo: When you’re sure you can win and Olaf R Ragnarok has ended, trade with Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash → three empowered basic attacks. Positioning so your blade passes through Olaf increases the damage and attack speed of your empowered basic attacks.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so once Olaf R Ragnarok ends, use Shen E Shadow Dash to catch him if you have a clear engage angle. You can also approach after preventing him from picking up Olaf Q Undertow’s axe. Shen E Shadow Dash is Shen’s only movement ability, so use it first only when you can win.
Olaf.fight: Early on, avoid long fights and take short trades when Shen Q Twilight Assault lets your blade pass through Olaf. Block Olaf’s basic attacks with Shen W Spirit's Refuge, but keep in mind that it can’t block Olaf Q Undertow or Olaf E Reckless Swing. Even as Olaf’s health decreases, his attack speed and healing become stronger, so don’t recklessly stick to him until the end.
Olaf.laning: Early on, manage the wave safely and avoid giving up a kill instead of forcing trades. Move to the side opposite where Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands so he can’t approach while picking it up. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Olaf.phase: Olaf becomes relatively weaker as the game goes on, and Shen looks for chances to support allies whenever Shen R Stand United comes back up.
Olaf.teamfight: Protect your allied damage dealers from behind, and manage your blade position to block Olaf’s basic attacks with Shen W Spirit's Refuge when he approaches. Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt doesn’t work during Olaf R Ragnarok, so create distance and wait for it to end. Then use Shen E Shadow Dash to taunt Olaf away from your allied damage dealers.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows and lowers armor, so move opposite the direction where the axe lands to prevent him from picking it up. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that armor can’t reduce, so when your health is low, respond with Shen P Ki Barrier and distance. Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt doesn’t work while Olaf R Ragnarok is active, so create distance and use it after it ends.

Ornn.build: Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your max health, so avoid first building a large amount of health alone. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so consider building both armor and magic resistance. The available information does not specify a particular first item for Shen.
Ornn.combo: Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to make the Spirit Blade pass through Ornn, then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash and land three empowered attacks. If you need to block an empowered basic attack during Ornn's counterattack, check the Spirit Blade's position and use Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
Ornn.escape: A good window to engage is after both Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are down. If only one is down, he can still escape with the other, so don't use Shen E Shadow Dash too hastily. If Ornn W Bellows Breath made you Brittle, wait for the effect to end before engaging.
Ornn.fight: Position the Spirit Blade so it passes through Ornn, then pull it back with Shen Q Twilight Assault and land empowered attacks. Shen W Spirit's Refuge cannot block Ornn W Bellows Breath damage, so use it against Ornn's empowered basic attacks. Save Shen E Shadow Dash to respond to Ornn's engage, and check that you can win the trade before engaging first.
Ornn.laning: Early on, repeat short trades instead of taking extended fights, and manage the wave safely. Stick close to Ornn and disrupt him if he tries to forge an item in lane. If you see an opportunity to join another lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward the enemy turret ahead of time.
Ornn.phase: Shen is weak early, but Ornn's early damage is also low, so create opportunities to get ahead with safe short trades and by disrupting his forging. In the mid and late game, play around the cooldown of Shen R Stand United and pressure Ornn before he builds up items and upgrades for his allies.
Ornn.teamfight: Stay near your allied damage dealers and taunt Ornn with Shen E Shadow Dash when he engages. Manage the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers your damage dealers and blocks Ornn's empowered basic attacks. If Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes in, dodge the ram to the side and stay out of the straight line where Ornn can send it back.
Ornn.watch: Stand away from the pillar created by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and from walls. Ornn E Searing Charge knocks you up if it hits the pillar or a wall, so move toward open space when he prepares to charge. If you are made Brittle by the final blast of Ornn W Bellows Breath, keep your distance until the effect ends.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first because Pantheon's main ability damage is physical. Basic attacks are also a major part of his damage, so fit Thornmail between your core items and block his basic attacks with Shen W Spirit's Refuge. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Pantheon.combo: From an angle where the Spirit Blade will pass through Pantheon, use Shen Q Twilight Assault, then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash and land three empowered attacks. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking from the front, wait to attack or attack from the side.
Pantheon.escape: Look for a chance to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash when Pantheon W Shield Vault is down. Before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up, his mobility is limited. Shen E Shadow Dash is Shen's only mobility ability, so use it first only when you are sure to win.
Pantheon.fight: Avoid trading hits early, and take short trades after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down. Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to make the Spirit Blade pass through Pantheon, then land empowered attacks. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, stop attacking from the front and wait it out or move to the side.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions when Pantheon uses a long-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear for poke. If a fight in another lane is likely, push the wave toward the enemy turret and get ready to use Shen R Stand United.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's impact falls off as the game goes on, while Shen's strength follows the cooldown of Shen R Stand United.
Pantheon.teamfight: If Pantheon jumps onto an allied damage dealer with Pantheon W Shield Vault, taunt him away with Shen E Shadow Dash. Keep the Spirit Blade beside your damage dealer and use Shen W Spirit's Refuge to block Pantheon's basic attacks, remembering that it cannot block ability damage. After your ally actually takes damage, assess whether they can survive and protect them with Shen R Stand United.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so be careful not to enter its range. Keep minions between you and Pantheon when taking poke from Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, so wait for it to end or move around to the side.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy's main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. Don't spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, position so the Spirit Blade can pass through Poppy, then use Shen Q Twilight Assault, taunt with Shen E Shadow Dash, and land three empowered attacks. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock creates a zone, walk out instead of insisting on basic attacks.
Poppy.escape: Poppy E Heroic Charge is an opportunity to close the gap right after she uses it. However, if Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it blocks Shen E Shadow Dash, so wait for it to end or walk up to her. Choose an approach that doesn't leave a wall behind you.
Poppy.fight: Angle Shen Q Twilight Assault so the Spirit Blade passes through Poppy, then take a short trade with empowered attacks. Shen W Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks but not ability damage such as Poppy Q Hammer Shock, so use it based on the Spirit Blade's position. Use Shen E Shadow Dash to engage only when Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended and you are sure to win.
Poppy.laning: Manage the wave safely without letting a wall or narrow passage be at your back. When Poppy's thrown shield lands, step on it first to deny her shield, and have Shen Q Twilight Assault graze Poppy to make Shen P Ki Barrier come back sooner. If you see an opportunity to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward Poppy's turret ahead of time.
Poppy.phase: In the mid and late game, join fights with your allies around the cooldown of Shen R Stand United.
Poppy.teamfight: Taunt Poppy with Shen E Shadow Dash to peel her off an allied damage dealer, but wait out Poppy W Steadfast Presence if it is active. Position the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers your damage dealer. Use Shen R Stand United after your ally actually takes damage, when they can survive until the channel completes.
Poppy.watch: Do not engage with Shen E Shadow Dash while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. Stand in open space, since Poppy E Heroic Charge can stun you against a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you once, walk out of the zone before the second hit. If you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move to the side from in front of her.

Quinn.build: Prioritize armor against Quinn's damage. Quinn also deals damage with basic attacks, so fit Thornmail between your core items. Magic resistance does not help against this opponent.
Quinn.combo: Check the Spirit Blade's position and use Shen Q Twilight Assault first so the blade passes through Quinn. Then taunt her with Shen E Shadow Dash and land three empowered attacks. If Quinn retaliates with basic attacks, use Shen W Spirit's Refuge where the Spirit Blade is.
Quinn.escape: Quinn E Vault is her escape, so the moment after she uses it is your chance to engage. Before then, don't force Shen E Shadow Dash first. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, you have no mobility to escape, so engage only when you can land the taunt.
Quinn.fight: Early on, don't start a fight while in Quinn's range. Close the gap and taunt with Shen E Shadow Dash right after Quinn E Vault is down or when your jungler arrives. Block Quinn's basic attacks by placing Shen W Spirit's Refuge where the Spirit Blade is.
Quinn.laning: Early on, protect your CS and health while managing the wave safely. Farm when Quinn P Harrier is not marking you, and move outside her basic attack range when it does. If you see an opportunity to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret ahead of time.
Quinn.teamfight: If Quinn approaches from the side, taunt her with Shen E Shadow Dash to keep her off your allied damage dealers. Keep the Spirit Blade near them and use Shen W Spirit's Refuge to block Quinn's basic attacks. Protect your back line and keep fighting as a team instead of pushing deep forward.
Quinn.watch: If Quinn P Harrier marks you, move outside her basic attack range to avoid her empowered attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind the minion line, and don't cast Shen E Shadow Dash while your vision is reduced. Quinn E Vault knocks Shen back and makes Quinn retreat as well, so don't force an approach before she uses it.

Riven.build: Build armor first because Riven's main damage is physical. Fit Thornmail between your core items to complement Shen W Spirit's Refuge, which blocks basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade. Also build health to prepare for her finishing damage.
Riven.combo: The basic sequence is Shen Q Twilight Assault, Shen E Shadow Dash, then three empowered attacks. When Riven follows up with basic attacks, check the Spirit Blade's position and use Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
Riven.escape: Don't engage first just because one cast of Riven Q Broken Wings is down. Wait until Riven Q Broken Wings is down and you have confirmed that Riven E Valor has also been used, then use Shen E Shadow Dash to start a trade you can win. It's safer to save Shen E Shadow Dash to counterattack right after Riven engages.
Riven.fight: If Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, take a short trade while her main damage and escape are down. If she engages first, use Shen E Shadow Dash to interrupt her remaining combo, and Shen W Spirit's Refuge to block basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade. Shen W Spirit's Refuge cannot block ability damage from Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven W Ki Burst.
Riven.laning: Watch the Spirit Blade's position and take a short trade with empowered attacks and Shen P Ki Barrier when you can angle Shen Q Twilight Assault to pass through Riven. If you see an opportunity to go to another lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward the enemy turret ahead of time.
Riven.phase: In the mid and late game, focus on helping your allies around the cooldown of Shen R Stand United.
Riven.teamfight: Taunt Riven with Shen E Shadow Dash to peel her off an allied damage dealer, and position the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active where your damage dealer is. Use Shen R Stand United after your ally starts taking damage, but delay it if nearby Riven still has her third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven W Ki Burst available, since they can interrupt the channel.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are used for chained dashes, so move back when you see the first dash. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her attack damage and range increase, and the finishing damage that scales with missing health is dangerous, so keep your distance until its duration ends.

Rumble.build: Prioritize defensive items with magic resistance. Rumble's main damage is magic, and Rumble E Electro Harpoon reduces magic resistance, so building only armor or health is inefficient. If surviving remains difficult, choose a magic-resistance item such as Bandlepipes for your third item as well.
Rumble.combo: Check where to stand so the Spirit Blade passes through Rumble, then use Shen Q Twilight Assault, taunt with Shen E Shadow Dash, and land three empowered attacks. If Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, start the combo after the shield disappears.
Rumble.escape: If you are hit by the first charge of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, use Shen E Shadow Dash to escape before the second one comes. Once Rumble W Scrap Shield's shield has disappeared and you have dodged Rumble E Electro Harpoon, look for an opportunity to engage. Rumble has no mobility ability, but Shen E Shadow Dash is also Shen's only mobility ability, so engage only when you are sure to win.
Rumble.fight: Let Rumble walk forward, trade briefly, and save Shen E Shadow Dash. If Rumble activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, wait briefly for the shield to disappear. Then, when you have an angle for Shen Q Twilight Assault to pass through Rumble and can win, engage with Shen E Shadow Dash.
Rumble.laning: Have Shen Q Twilight Assault graze Rumble to trigger Shen P Ki Barrier more often, and don't stay in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter for long. If you see an opportunity to go to another lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Rumble.phase: In the mid and late game, play around the cooldown of Shen R Stand United and protect your back line in teamfights.
Rumble.teamfight: Stay near your allied damage dealers and manage the Spirit Blade's position. Taunt approaching opponents with Shen E Shadow Dash. Use Shen W Spirit's Refuge to block basic attacks, not Rumble's main ability damage. Use Shen R Stand United after an ally actually takes damage, when they can survive until the channel completes.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage while he is close, so create distance when he approaches. If you are hit by the first charge of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, use Shen E Shadow Dash to escape before the second one comes. Shen W Spirit's Refuge cannot block Rumble's main ability damage.

Sett.build: Build armor first to handle the basic attack damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Since this opponent relies heavily on basic attacks, fit Thornmail between your core items and block basic attacks with Shen W Spirit's Refuge. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down scales with your max health, so don't rely on stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: Position so the Spirit Blade passes through Sett, then use Shen Q Twilight Assault, taunt with Shen E Shadow Dash, and land three empowered attacks. Shen Q Twilight Assault empowers your next basic attack, so don't use Q and then back off. If Sett retaliates with basic attacks, use Shen W Spirit's Refuge where the Spirit Blade is, then back away before Sett W Haymaker gets stronger.
Sett.escape: Engage while Sett E Facebreaker is down or Sett R The Show Stopper is down. If Sett W Haymaker comes out after you engage, move to the side of the center of its indicator.
Sett.fight: Use Shen Q Twilight Assault from an angle that sends the Spirit Blade through Sett and back to Shen, then take a short trade with empowered attacks. Block Sett's basic attacks by placing Shen W Spirit's Refuge where the Spirit Blade is. After dealing damage, back away while Sett W Haymaker gets stronger, then fight again once his Grit has faded.
Sett.laning: Have Shen Q Twilight Assault graze Sett to make Shen P Ki Barrier available again sooner. If you see an opportunity to join another lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward Sett's turret first.
Sett.teamfight: If Sett gets onto an allied damage dealer, taunt him away with Shen E Shadow Dash and manage the Spirit Blade so you can use Shen W Spirit's Refuge where your damage dealer is. Sett W Haymaker is not a basic attack that Spirit's Refuge can block, so dodge the center of its indicator. Use Shen R Stand United after your ally actually takes damage, when they can survive until the channel completes.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker gets stronger after Sett takes damage, so back away after trading and sidestep the center of its indicator when it activates. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when enemies are on both sides of him, so don't stand opposite minions with Sett between you and them. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it grabs you, so when Sett has his ultimate ready, watch for positions where he can throw you toward your allies.

Singed.build: Singed’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance and make your third item something that grants magic resistance, such as Bandlepipes. Shen W Spirit's Refuge does not block Singed’s ability damage, so do not rely on it to survive. Also consider movement speed so you can walk out of areas covered by Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.combo: From an angle where the Spirit Blade will pass through Singed, attack in this order: Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash taunt → three empowered attacks. Use Q first so you can spend the taunt duration on empowered attacks. You cannot use E on Singed W Mega Adhesive, so start the combo after leaving the adhesive.
Singed.escape: Avoid areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive, then use Shen E Shadow Dash to engage while Singed cannot use Singed E Fling. Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you have a clear angle to land your taunt, catch him and attack briefly. Keep in mind that using E to engage leaves you without a mobility ability to escape.
Singed.fight: When Singed runs away while leaving poison behind, do not follow; trade briefly instead. Set up Shen Q Twilight Assault so the Spirit Blade passes through Singed, then land empowered attacks. Shen E Shadow Dash leaves you open to a counterattack if it misses, so engage only when you can reliably catch him.
Singed.laning: After that, do not overchase through the poison; manage the wave safely. If you see an opportunity to join another lane with Shen R Stand United, first push the wave toward the enemy turret.
Singed.phase: Once Singed has his core items, do not chase him for long to try to kill him. In the mid and late game, focus your play around opportunities to use Shen R Stand United.
Singed.teamfight: If Singed runs into your team, taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash to pin him down and give your allies time to attack his team. Do not chase him all the way through his poison. When protecting an allied damage dealer, check the Spirit Blade’s position and place Shen W Spirit's Refuge on the carry, but remember that the zone cannot block Singed’s ability damage.
Singed.watch: Do not chase Singed when his health is low while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail. You cannot use Shen E Shadow Dash on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and if Singed E Fling hits you there, you will also be rooted, so go around the adhesive. If Singed has his back to his allies, keep your distance so Singed E Fling cannot toss you into the enemy team.

Sion.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Sion W Soul Furnace or Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and Sion E Roar of the Slayer also reduces armor, so it is important to dodge it.
Sion.combo: Set up an angle for the Spirit Blade to pass through Sion and cast Shen Q Twilight Assault first. Then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash and land three empowered attacks. If you only use Shen Q Twilight Assault and back off, you cannot make use of the empowered attack damage.
Sion.escape: Once Sion Q Decimating Smash finishes charging and you have avoided its crowd control, you have an opportunity to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. However, using Shen E Shadow Dash to engage leaves you without a way out, so judge your odds before going in.
Sion.fight: Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to make the Spirit Blade pass through Sion, then trade briefly with empowered attacks that deal increased percent maximum-health damage. Right after Sion W Soul Furnace activates, you have a chance to break the shield quickly and prevent the explosion. Using Shen E Shadow Dash to engage leaves you unable to escape, so use it first only when you are sure to win.
Sion.laning: Early on, manage the wave safely instead of forcing trades, and repeat short trades by landing Shen Q Twilight Assault. Sion’s maximum health increases as he kills units, so disrupt his farming or make gains in other lanes. If you may leave with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward the enemy turret beforehand.
Sion.phase: Sion’s maximum health increases over time, so in the mid and late game, use opportunities with Shen R Stand United to make gains in other lanes.
Sion.teamfight: Taunt Sion with Shen E Shadow Dash to peel him off an allied damage dealer, and keep the Spirit Blade near the carry so Shen W Spirit's Refuge can block basic attacks. Shen W Spirit's Refuge cannot block ability damage, so dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught separately. Use Shen R Stand United to protect an ally once they start taking damage, when they can survive until the channel completes.
Sion.watch: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, step to the side to avoid the stun and knock-up. Dodge Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught to the side as well, and do not meet him in narrow passages or paths along walls. After Sion goes down, reposition to avoid the fast attacks and percent maximum-health damage from Sion P Glory in Death.

Skarner.build: If you need to remove Skarner R Impale’s suppression yourself, consider Quicksilver Sash first. For defensive stats, prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.combo: If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down and you can win even after engaging, use Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash taunt → three empowered attacks. Use Shen Q Twilight Assault first so you can fit empowered attacks into the taunt duration. Set up an angle for the Spirit Blade to pass through Skarner to increase percent maximum-health damage and attack speed. When Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval’s empowered attack is coming, check the Spirit Blade’s position and block it with Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
Skarner.escape: The window to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash is right after you bait Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Shen E Shadow Dash cannot remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale, so do not engage expecting to escape after being suppressed.
Skarner.fight: The moment after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down is an opportunity to close the distance and fight. At that point, cast Shen Q Twilight Assault so the Spirit Blade passes through Skarner, then trade briefly with empowered attacks. Using Shen E Shadow Dash first leaves you without a mobility ability to escape, so engage only in trades you can win.
Skarner.laning: Early on, do not stand with your back to a wall; manage the wave safely and repeat short trades. If Shen Q Twilight Assault’s Spirit Blade brushes past Skarner, Shen P Ki Barrier comes back up faster. If you see signs of an opportunity to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret beforehand.
Skarner.phase: As Skarner builds tank items, both his damage and durability increase, so it is important to delay his item timings with early jungle control and objectives.
Skarner.teamfight: Stay behind your allied damage dealers and peel Skarner off them with the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash when he engages. Keep the Spirit Blade near the carry and use Shen W Spirit's Refuge to block Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval’s empowered attacks. Shen W Spirit's Refuge cannot block the suppression from Skarner R Impale, so have the carry keep their distance from Skarner and his allies.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain, stuns if it hits a wall, and lets him re-engage faster, so do not stand with your back to a wall. Shen E Shadow Dash cannot free you from Skarner R Impale’s suppression, so keep your distance from Skarner and his allies. Stay outside melee range to avoid repeatedly taking empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.

Teemo.build: Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap deal most of his damage as magic, so build magic resistance first. If you need durability from your third item as well, choose something that grants magic resistance, such as Bandlepipes.
Teemo.combo: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, go in with Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash → three empowered attacks.
