Check the Spirit Blade’s position first, then set up an angle with Shen Q Twilight Assault so the blade passes through Teemo. If you only use Shen Q Twilight Assault and back off, you cannot make use of the empowered attack damage.
Teemo.escape: The moment after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down is an opportunity to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. Teemo W Move Quick increases his movement speed, so account for that effect and engage when Shen E Shadow Dash will hit. Using Shen E Shadow Dash to engage leaves you without a mobility ability to escape, so use it first only when you are sure to win.
Teemo.fight: Start a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. If you have closed the distance with Shen E Shadow Dash, avoid trades where you hit briefly and back off only to take poison damage; stay on him until you can land empowered attacks. Use Shen W Spirit's Refuge to block Teemo’s basic attacks, but it will not block ability damage from Teemo Q Blinding Dart or Teemo R Noxious Trap.
Teemo.laning: Early on, manage the wave safely so Teemo cannot hit you with one basic attack at a time from within his range. Check bushes you have no vision of with a Control Ward or go around them, then wait for the stealthed Teemo to appear before retaliating. If you see an opportunity to go to another lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward the enemy turret beforehand.
Teemo.phase: In the mid and late game, Shen R Stand United’s cooldown becomes one of Shen’s strengths. Move with your allies so Teemo does not keep getting time to set up mushrooms.
Teemo.teamfight: Taunt an enemy who is on an allied damage dealer with Shen E Shadow Dash to peel them off, and manage the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers the carry. In front of objectives and in narrow passages, anticipate Teemo R Noxious Trap and use Oracle Lens to check key routes. Use Shen R Stand United once an ally actually starts taking damage and can survive until the channel completes.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault, so do not basic attack while the blind remains; back off instead. Teemo E Toxic Shot applies poison damage even if you are hit by just one basic attack, so stay out of range unless you are ready to commit.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. He also relies on basic attacks and critical strikes, so fit Thornmail between your core items.
Tryndamere.combo: Set up Shen Q Twilight Assault so the Spirit Blade passes through Tryndamere, then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash and land three empowered attacks. If Tryndamere fights back with basic attacks, check the blade’s position and block them with Shen W Spirit's Refuge.
Tryndamere.escape: The moment after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down is an opportunity to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. In areas with many minions, Tryndamere’s critical strikes make Tryndamere E Spinning Slash come back quickly, so do not chase him there for long. When backing off, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.fight: Trade briefly right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down. If you use Shen E Shadow Dash to engage first, you have no way out, so go in only when you are sure to win. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance and deal damage again after it ends.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, manage the wave safely while preventing Tryndamere from building Fury with last hits. Once Tryndamere starts building Fury, create distance before he can get on you, and avoid a basic-attack fight right after Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you. If you see an opportunity to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret beforehand.
Tryndamere.phase: Even in the late game, do not try to defend a side lane alone against Tryndamere with Tryndamere R Undying Rage ready; trade for an objective or send more allies.
Tryndamere.teamfight: If Tryndamere gets onto an allied damage dealer, taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash to peel him off. Manage the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers the carry and blocks Tryndamere’s basic attacks.
Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere hits minions to build Fury, watch out for critical strikes and healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust, and create distance. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is a dash, so distinguish it from basic attacks that Shen W Spirit's Refuge can block. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, do not pour in damage; buy time with the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash or create distance.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage. Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both physical and magic damage, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone cannot block all of it. Both abilities deal percent maximum-health damage, so avoid choices that add a large amount of health alone, and consider an option that reduces attack speed.
Udyr.combo: From an angle where the Spirit Blade will pass through Udyr, cast Shen Q Twilight Assault first, then land three empowered attacks after the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. While Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered basic attack is coming in, activate Shen W Spirit's Refuge with the blade positioned to protect Shen.
Udyr.escape: Right after you bait Udyr into using Udyr E Blazing Stampede, you have a window to close the distance or escape. If you have already been stunned once, use the interval when Udyr cannot immediately stun the same target again. Immobilizing effects do not work during Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened state, so taunt with Shen E Shadow Dash or escape after the Awakened state ends.
Udyr.fight: Attack in a short burst after the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone. Set up Shen Q Twilight Assault so the Spirit Blade passes through Udyr and land empowered attacks; use Shen W Spirit's Refuge when Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered basic attack is coming. Choose a fight where you use Shen E Shadow Dash to engage first only when you are sure to win.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so ward key routes and jungle entrances, and do not push up in lane when he is unseen. Early on, Shen should focus on managing the wave safely instead of forcing trades. If you see signs of an opportunity to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret beforehand.
Udyr.phase: The available information is not enough to determine whether Udyr or Shen is stronger in the early, mid, or late game.
Udyr.teamfight: Do not force a kill on Udyr first when he has tank items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. If Udyr gets onto an allied damage dealer, peel him off with Shen E Shadow Dash and manage the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit's Refuge covers the carry. Taunt him after Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened state ends, then take out weaker allies behind Udyr first to create a numbers advantage.
Udyr.watch: Watch for a stun right after Udyr E Blazing Stampede activates. Block empowered basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw with Shen W Spirit's Refuge, but keep your distance because the zone cannot block damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm.

Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If you need to counter his basic attack damage, fit Thornmail between your core items. But be wary of building only health, since Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on the target’s maximum health.
Urgot.combo: When you get a chance to trade, use Shen Q Twilight Assault → Shen E Shadow Dash → three empowered basic attacks. Position the Spirit Blade so it passes through Urgot to use Shen Q Twilight Assault’s damage based on maximum health and its attack speed increase. Shen W Spirit’s Refuge appears where the blade is, so check its position before casting.
Urgot.escape: Right after Urgot E Disdain is used is your window to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. When Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits and his fire focuses on you, don’t try to walk out too late; decide whether to escape with Shen E Shadow Dash or Shen R Stand United.
Urgot.fight: Avoid fights where you stay close to Urgot and get hit by his leg cannons repeatedly. If he approaches with Urgot W Purge active, walk out of its firing range. Right after he uses Urgot E Disdain, look for a chance to close the gap with Shen E Shadow Dash and trade briefly.
Urgot.laning: Early on, focus on safe farming and wave management instead of fighting him head-on. Don’t use Shen E Shadow Dash first and leave yourself without an escape while Urgot E Disdain is available. If you see a chance to use Shen R Stand United in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret beforehand.
Urgot.phase: In the mid to late game, look for fights in step with Shen R Stand United coming off cooldown.
Urgot.teamfight: Position yourself to protect your allied damage dealers, and taunt enemies who approach with Shen E Shadow Dash. Manage the Spirit Blade’s position so Shen W Spirit’s Refuge appears where your damage dealers are. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so stand on the frontline to reduce its chance of reaching the damage dealers behind you.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on the target’s maximum health, so don’t stay near him for long. Urgot Q Corrosive Charge heavily slows and marks targets for Urgot W Purge, so decide immediately whether to dodge it with Shen E Shadow Dash as it comes in. If you’re hit by Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, get out of range before your health reaches the execution threshold.

Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul is a problem, consider an anti-heal item. Volibear P The Relentless Storm and E Sky Splitter deal magic damage, so armor alone won’t stop them. Lowering his attack speed also reduces the basic attacks you take.
Volibear.combo: First use Shen Q Twilight Assault with the Spirit Blade positioned to pass through Volibear, then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash and land three empowered basic attacks. If Volibear counterattacks with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, block the empowered basic attack inside Shen W Spirit’s Refuge, which appears at the blade’s position. If you use only Shen Q Twilight Assault and back off, you won’t deal empowered basic attack damage, so make sure you have time for a short trade.
Volibear.escape: Look for a chance to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash after Volibear Q Thundering Smash is used and before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back up. If only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, don’t engage first; account for his remaining dash. Shen E Shadow Dash is also needed to escape, so use it to engage only when you have a clear chance of winning.
Volibear.fight: Avoid fighting while Volibear approaches and stacks Volibear P The Relentless Storm; trade briefly after the stacks fall off. Block Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s empowered basic attack with Shen W Spirit’s Refuge, and walk out of the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter. Volibear can heal with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, so don’t fight for long unless you have a clear chance to finish him.
Volibear.laning: Use Shen Q Twilight Assault with the Spirit Blade positioned to pass through Volibear, then trade briefly with empowered basic attacks. If you see a chance to join another lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Volibear.phase: In the mid to late game, support your allies in step with Shen R Stand United coming off cooldown, and protect the backline in teamfights.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear gets on an allied damage dealer, taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash to peel him off. Keep the Spirit Blade near your damage dealer and block Volibear’s basic attacks with Shen W Spirit’s Refuge. If Volibear has fully stacked Volibear P The Relentless Storm, wait for the stacks to fall off before fighting him instead of engaging immediately.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash stuns with an empowered basic attack, so check the Spirit Blade’s position and block the attack with Shen W Spirit’s Refuge. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. While Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under your turret just because your health is low; retreat farther in.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath, his main sources of damage. Since he deals damage with basic attacks, fitting Thornmail between your core items can improve your defenses alongside Shen W Spirit’s Refuge. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade’s magic damage can’t be blocked with armor.
Yasuo.combo: Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to angle the Spirit Blade so it passes through Yasuo and returns to Shen, then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash. Follow with three empowered basic attacks. Use Q first so you can land empowered attacks during the taunt; if you use only Q and back off, you’ll deal very little damage.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo sends out his tornado, his Q stacks reset, giving you a chance to engage. Look for an opening to land Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has a short cooldown, so don’t engage just because he used it once.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with light damage first, then make a short trade. Look for an opening right after he sends out his tornado and his stacks reset. Once you’re close, block his basic attacks with Shen W Spirit’s Refuge. Shen E Shadow Dash leaves you open to a counterattack if it misses, so use it only when you can land it reliably.
Yasuo.laning: Keeping a thin wave on your side of the lane reduces the minions Yasuo can use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Prioritize safe wave management and short trades over forcing damage. If you see a chance to join another lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Yasuo.phase: In the mid to late game, the strategy of joining allied fights whenever R becomes available again grows stronger.
Yasuo.teamfight: If Yasuo gets on an allied damage dealer, taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash to peel him off. Manage the Spirit Blade’s position so Shen W Spirit’s Refuge appears where your damage dealer is. Use Shen R Stand United after an ally starts taking damage, when they can survive until the channel finishes.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move to the side to dodge as he approaches. After he lands Q twice, his next Q will knock you up as a tornado, so listen and watch for the effect and prepare to dodge. Also watch out for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade as he dashes in through minions.

Yone.build: Prioritize attack speed reduction, which can delay the cooldowns of Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone W Spirit Cleave. Yone deals mixed damage, so don’t focus on just one resistance. Avoid building a lot of health alone, since Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on the target’s maximum health.
Yone.combo: With an angle for the Spirit Blade to pass through Yone, use Shen Q Twilight Assault first, then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash and land three empowered basic attacks. If Yone is using Yone E Soul Unbound to engage, save Shen E Shadow Dash to meet that engage.
Yone.escape: After Yone uses his tornado Q and enters with Yone E Soul Unbound, you have a chance to taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash. Yone has several ways to move, so don’t dash in just because one is down; look especially for the window before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up.
Yone.fight: Don’t close the gap first while Yone’s tornado Q is ready. If Yone E Soul Unbound takes him in, stop his return with Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt and take his basic attacks inside Shen W Spirit’s Refuge. Shen W Spirit’s Refuge can’t block ability damage, so don’t rely on it to take a long fight.
Yone.laning: Watch the Spirit Blade’s position and use Shen Q Twilight Assault to send it through Yone, making use of empowered basic attacks and Shen P Ki Barrier. If a fight is expected in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret to reduce the cost of leaving lane with Shen R Stand United.
Yone.teamfight: Taunt Yone with Shen E Shadow Dash when he dives onto an allied damage dealer, and position the Spirit Blade so Shen W Spirit’s Refuge appears where your damage dealer is. Keep your distance from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave can’t hit several of you and build a larger shield. Check whether you’re standing farthest back along the path of Yone R Fate Sealed.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, wait out of range for the stacks to disappear. After Yone E Soul Unbound takes him in, he can deal extra damage when he returns, so get out of range in advance if your health is low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so don’t stand in line with your allies during teamfights.

Yorick.build: Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers’ attacks deal physical damage, so build armor first. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on the target’s maximum health, so avoid building a lot of health alone.
Yorick.combo: Use Shen Q Twilight Assault to make the Spirit Blade pass through Yorick, then taunt him with Shen E Shadow Dash. Follow with three empowered basic attacks to use Shen Q Twilight Assault’s damage and attack speed increase. While you need to take Yorick’s basic attacks, check the blade’s position and use Shen W Spirit’s Refuge.
Yorick.escape: When Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, you have an opportunity to step forward to farm or trade. Yorick has no mobility, so if you have a clear angle to engage, you can catch him with Shen E Shadow Dash. If there’s still a chance you’ll be trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, consider saving Shen E Shadow Dash as an escape.
Yorick.fight: Dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist and clear the Mist Walkers before making a short trade. Block Yorick’s basic attacks with Shen W Spirit’s Refuge, but it can’t block the ability damage from Yorick E Mourning Mist or Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles. Shen E Shadow Dash is also an escape tool, so use it to engage only when you can clearly win.
Yorick.laning: Don’t fight where many graves have built up, and push toward the enemy turret so Yorick can’t clear the wave on his side. Early on, safe wave management is more important for Shen than forcing damage trades. If you see a chance to leave lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave first to reduce your lane losses.
Yorick.phase: In the mid to late game, use Shen R Stand United to catch a side lane, then join your team to create a numbers advantage.
Yorick.teamfight: Taunt enemies who get on allied damage dealers with Shen E Shadow Dash, and manage the Spirit Blade so your damage dealers can stand inside Shen W Spirit’s Refuge. For fights elsewhere, use Shen R Stand United after an ally starts taking damage, and check that they can survive until the channel finishes.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on the target’s maximum health, so dodge the orb’s trajectory. If the Maiden of the Mist marks you with a basic attack, Yorick’s basic attacks deal extra damage, so keep your distance from him. If you’re trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, attack the wall to break it or cross it with Shen E Shadow Dash.
